verdict.rationale: Paddle documents payout reconciliation reports that can be generated via the API and that reconcile payouts to transactions and adjustments, with itemized fees and balance movements. Its hosted MCP server lets agents generate reports and chain any API call, so an agent can plausibly pull this data. However, reconciliation is delivered as a generated report rather than documented payout or balance-transaction endpoints an agent can query per bank deposit, so depth is unproven. Missing for 10: documented payout and balance-transaction API resources for direct per-deposit lookup, evidence that an agent can match each individual bank deposit to its charges end-to-end, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent pull payout and balance-transaction data via the API and reconcile each bank deposit to its underlying charges
